fusions.name: Grazed Down
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A cropping bite that deals 9 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tenderised
fusions.desc: A pounding weapon strike that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Stomach
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Laden Feedbag
fusions.desc: Conjures a laden feedbag: your maximum health rises by 15, each kill returns 4 health, your critical chance rises by 4% and your critical hits deal 0.1x more. Its effect increases by 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
